objective: A frozen census of doubling schedules (5 x 5 at g = 2, 3, 5; 7 x 7 at g = 3; two and three runs): time lengths between original rings and between their position-1 cells, each read through freezes; tests X1 (no triangle excess within a stage), X2 (the time per original spacing along an axis is 4g 2^k in stage k) and X3 (the round trip in conformal time, a lag of stage k counted as 2^-k, satisfies the triangle inequality); code 2 on a sample; the known balanced schedules reported apart.
title: The expansion read from time lengths
